claims.statement: App use requires installation on the relevant account; enterprise installation is feature-conditional and multiple account installations remain distinct. Requested organization/repository and conditional enterprise permissions are granted through installation, with repository selection when repository permissions are requested.

Before installation the source recommends assessing owner trust and requested permissions. Its no-install-count-limit statement does not authorize unlimited installations, establish least privilege or prove effective access.

Saving changed App settings is not proof new permissions took effect: the fragment requires installer acceptance via email or installations review. Its broad permissions-or-webhooks wording requires reconciliation against exact update contracts; installation users include the owner. No acceptance is inferred or performed.

Regular App vulnerability scans are recommended, with code and secret scanning on the code repository offered as examples. These optional mechanism examples are not a universal product mandate or evidence of actual scan execution/findings; linked feature guides remain separate.
